name: Candlelight: The Best of ABBA
description: ABBA songs arranged for string quartet, played by candlelight at the Hilton Porto Gaia on Saturday 2 January at 21:00. Tickets from €13.20.
longDescription:
This Candlelight concert is a tribute to ABBA, played by a string quartet in a room lit by candles. It has no link to the band or its representatives.

The programme includes Dancing Queen, SOS, Money, Money, Money, The Winner Takes It All, Waterloo, Fernando, Chiquitita, Super Trouper and Mamma Mia, plus a few more. The concert lasts 60 minutes. It's open to ages 8 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult.

It's on Saturday 2 January 2027 at 21:00 at the Hilton Porto Gaia in Vila Nova de Gaia. Doors open 30 minutes before the start and close 5 minutes before it, with no entry after the show begins. Seats are given out on arrival in order of arrival, within your ticket type. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tickets from €13.20.
